versions.changelog:
- Internal changes to scripts/setup-device-code.sh with no user-facing changes.
- No updates to user documentation or functionality.

**Outlook To Do now uses its own app registration and device-code auth, no longer sharing auth with other Outlook skills.**

- Switched to standalone device-code login and token storage under `~/.outlook-todo/`
- Consent now requests only three delegated scopes: `offline_access`, `User.Read`, `Tasks.ReadWrite`
- Added scripts for device-code setup and token management: `setup-device-code.sh`, `token.sh`
- Updated documentation to reflect separate authentication flow and storage
- Removed shared auth/config with calendar and contacts skills; this skill must be set up independently
T09 fix: docs now accurately state that dry-run may perform read-only Graph lookups (default-list resolution, task fetch for display) but never writes - dry-run is not an offline mode.
Least-privilege fix per SkillSpector: remove OUTLOOK_CAL_LIB env override for sourcing the sibling library (fixed relative path, matching the contacts skill pattern); no other changes.
Description completeness: explicitly document task-list enumeration and task read/filter capabilities alongside write verbs (SkillSpector TP4 feedback). No functional changes.

Frontmatter/metadata honesty fixes per SkillSpector: description no longer claims calendar-only (family-shared consent fully disclosed), files.write path corrected to ~/.outlook-graph/, delete-confirmation help text matches --yes behavior.

Security hardening per SkillSpector findings: accurate scope disclosure (family-shared 5-scope consent stated in all docs), removed OPENCLAW_CLI confirmation bypass (explicit --yes flag is the only non-interactive path), runtime validation of authority/graph_base endpoints, chmod failures now fatal, contacts read-path guidance narrowed, todo write capability documented.
Add skill-card.md (hub disclosure card). No functional changes.
Initial release. Portable paths (no machine-specific dependencies), bring-your-own Azure app registration docs.
